about_the_game:
Deadlands: The Weird West: The Abominable Northwest

Pack your ammo, partner, 'cause we're heading for the Abominable Northwest, the latest trail guide and source book for Deadlands the Weird West! Trek over the snow-capped mountains of Idaho Territory searching for funds, fun, and fundaments, but was that the wind whipping through Snake River Canyon or something far more terrifying? Ride the Oregon Trail, where dysentery is now the least of everyone's problems. Do some logging in Washington, if the sasquatch let you. Ride the Iron Dragon to gloomy Seattle--assuming it's still standing. Inside the latest trail guide is a wealth of lore along with new Savage Tales, critters, locations, relics, and more!

<ul> <li> Over 40 NEW Foes to face and cryptids to encounter</li>
<li> A deep dive into the Idaho, Oregon, and Washington of the Weird West and the towns and notable locations therein!</li>
<li> Over 30 New Savage Tales tied to all these deadly locales</li>
</ul>"
